<h2> Description </h2>
'''E-245''' Will be the one of the entities you may encounter in [[Section E]], Possibly being the most complicated within the section. More info shown below.

<h2> Mechanic </h2>
Once spawned, it will rush to the main room at fast speeds, reaching the main room after around 5 seconds from when you first are able to hear it, once it reaches the main room it will stay idle for around 2 seconds before opening its mouth, becoming non-lethal and begin choosing a mechanic, it being shown in the center of its eye, which is located in the center of its mouth.

these mechanics are shown below under '''Chosen Mechanics'''.
<br><br><br><br><br><br>

<h2> Behavior </h2>
Once this mechanic is chosen, '''E-245''' will backtrack at moderate speeds, then after some time will rush to the main room again, hitting the door, then falling back once more, Leaving a trail of fire behind that damages you if in contact.

Simply hide, and avoid stepping on the fire.

<h2> Behavior </h2>
Once this mechanic is chosen, '''E-245''' will fall back at moderate speeds, then after a few seconds it will begin rushing back to the main room at fast speeds, destroying every single hiding spot, hitting the door, then falling back, despawning past voidwall.

To survive, the player has to dodge roll through it, or hide in a safe spot.

<h2> Behavior </h2>
Once this mechanic is chosen, '''E-245''' will backtrack at moderate speeds, then after some time will rush to the main room again slowly, filling the player's screen with static when nearby to warn players, hitting the door, then falling back once more.

To survive, you'll have to either hide or stay crouched.
</tabber>


<h2> Strategies </h2>
* '''E-245''' is extremely dangerous, especially with other entities active, so it is advised you wait for him to despawn before progressing.
** this can be deadly if not followed, as if it chooses '''Dodge''', you won't have anywhere to hide unless you find a safe spot.
* '''E-245'''<nowiki/>'s Burner mechanic has an insta-kill snipe in [[Red Rooms]], so prefer hiding quickly after '''E-245''' chooses that mechanic.
<h2> Trivia </h2>
* '''E-245''' used to be able to do its '''Dodge''' mechanic inside of [[Red Rooms]].
** This was changed due to it creating unfair combos, as [[E-30]] and [[E-60]] could still spawn during the encounter.
** '''E-245''' was going to be [[D-250]]'s old orb design/concept design for its main design, but this was changed.
